title: Lingguizhugan Decoction Alleviates Lung Inflammatory in Obstructive Sleep Apnea by Modulating ROS and HIF-1alpha Signaling Pathway Based on UHPLC-MS, Network Pharmacology, Transcriptomics, and Experimental Verification.
authors: Liu, Jinjin; Han, Li; Liu, Mengyu; Sun, Yipeng; Chen, Rui
journal: Rapid communications in mass spectrometry : RCM
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苓桂术甘汤通过ROS和HIF-1α信号通路缓解睡眠呼吸暂停肺炎症，虽含分子对接但核心为中药药理与湿实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: RATIONALE: Lingguizhugan decoction (LGZG) is a traditional Chinese formula that has been commonly used in obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) for relieving lung inflammation. However, the active substance of LGZG and the specific mechanism remain unclear. This study aims to identify the bioactive components of LGZG and subsequently elucidate the underlying therapeutic mechanisms against OSA based on mass spectrometry analysis, network pharmacology, transcriptomics, and experimental verification. METHODS: Ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography-high-resolution mass spectrometry (UHPLC-HRMS) was used to identify the main ingredients of LGZG. The OSA animal model was induced by chronic intermittent hypoxia (CIH) for 5 weeks in C57BL/6 mice. Transcriptome sequencing and network pharmacology were used to analyze potential mechanisms, which were further validated by molecular docking. HE staining was used for detecting lung inflammation. Immunohistochemistry (IHC), ELISA, and Western blot were employed to investigate protein expression, while quantitative real-time PCR (RT-qPCR) was used to determine gene expressions. Tissue reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels were measured by the DCFH-DA probe method. RESULTS: LGZG inhibited CIH-induced pulmonary inflammatory infiltration, protein concentration in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF), and suppressed IL-17 and IL-1beta gene expression. UHPLC-HRMS identified 482 compounds in the LGZG aqueous decoction. Network pharmacology analysis revealed that IL-6 and HIF-1alpha pathway were the major targets. Subsequently, transcriptomics analysis revealed that LGZG affected functions associated with ROS production and polymorphonuclear cells. LGZG suppressed the CIH-induced expression of neutrophil elastase and reduced MPO production in BALF. Furthermore, LGZG inhibited the IL-6 expression and secretion, and reduced CIH-induced ROS production. LGZG inhibited the CIH-induced activation of HIF-1alpha pathway. Moreover, molecular docking identified compounds in LGZG that could directly interact with the core targets IL-6, MPO, CYBB, and HIF-1alpha. CONCLUSIONS: LGZG alleviates CIH-induced pulmonary inflammation, neutrophil infiltration, and IL-6 secretion in mice. These effects are associated with the suppression of ROS production and inhibition of the HIF-1alpha signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: RATIONALE: 苓桂术甘汤（LGZG）是一种传统中药方剂，常用于阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）以缓解肺部炎症。然而，LGZG的活性物质及具体机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在基于质谱分析、网络药理学、转录组学和实验验证，鉴定LGZG的生物活性成分，并进一步阐明其对OSA的潜在治疗机制。方法：采用超高效液相色谱-高分辨质谱（UHPLC-HRMS）鉴定LGZG的主要成分。通过慢性间歇性缺氧（CIH）诱导C57BL/6小鼠5周建立OSA动物模型。利用转录组测序和网络药理学分析潜在机制，并通过分子对接进一步验证。采用HE染色检测肺部炎症。使用免疫组织化学（IHC）、ELISA和Western blot研究蛋白表达，而定量实时PCR（RT-qPCR）用于测定基因表达。通过DCFH-DA探针法测量组织活性氧（ROS）水平。结果：LGZG抑制了CIH诱导的肺部炎症浸润、支气管肺泡灌洗液（BALF）中蛋白浓度，并抑制IL-17和IL-1beta基因表达。UHPLC-HRMS在LGZG水提液中鉴定出482种化合物。网络药理学分析显示，IL-6和HIF-1alpha通路是主要靶点。随后，转录组学分析揭示LGZG影响与ROS产生和多形核细胞相关的功能。LGZG抑制了CIH诱导的中性粒细胞弹性蛋白酶表达，并减少了BALF中MPO的产生。此外，LGZG抑制了IL-6的表达和分泌，并减少了CIH诱导的ROS产生。LGZG抑制了CIH诱导的HIF-1alpha通路激活。此外，分子对接鉴定出LGZG中能与核心靶点IL-6、MPO、CYBB和HIF-1alpha直接相互作用的化合物。结论：LGZG减轻了小鼠中CIH诱导的肺部炎症、中性粒细胞浸润和IL-6分泌。这些效应与抑制ROS产生和抑制HIF-1alpha信号通路相关。
